having_IP_Address.description: Checks if the hostname is an IP address instead of a domain name.
having_IP_Address.rule: IP address used in domain part -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
having_IP_Address.plain_explanation_phishing: The URL uses a raw IP address instead of a recognized domain name, a tactic to obscure real host identity.
having_IP_Address.plain_explanation_legit: The URL uses a standard domain name.

URL_Length.description: Measures total character length of the URL.
URL_Length.plain_explanation_phishing: The URL is excessively long (> 75 chars), often used to hide the suspicious domain part.
URL_Length.plain_explanation_legit: The URL length is within normal standard bounds (< 54 chars).

Shortining_Service.description: Detects if URL shortening services (e.g., bit.ly, tinyurl) are used.
Shortining_Service.rule: Uses shortening service -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
Shortining_Service.plain_explanation_phishing: Uses a URL shortener to hide the real destination address.
Shortining_Service.plain_explanation_legit: Direct domain destination; no URL obfuscation service detected.

having_At_Symbol.description: Checks for the '@' symbol in the URL.
having_At_Symbol.plain_explanation_phishing: Contains '@' symbol, which causes browsers to ignore preceding text and route to the following host.
having_At_Symbol.plain_explanation_legit: No deceptive '@' authentication symbol detected in URL.

double_slash_redirecting.description: Detects double slash '//' occurring after the protocol.
double_slash_redirecting.rule: Last occurrence of '//' > position 7 -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
double_slash_redirecting.plain_explanation_phishing: Contains '//' deep inside the path, redirecting users to an unexpected host.
double_slash_redirecting.plain_explanation_legit: Clean path structure with standard protocol slash position.

Prefix_Suffix.description: Detects hyphen/dash ('-') inside the domain name.
Prefix_Suffix.plain_explanation_phishing: Domain name contains a hyphen ('-'), frequently used in brand spoofing (e.g. 'paypal-support.com').
Prefix_Suffix.plain_explanation_legit: Domain name does not contain deceptive hyphenated brand prefixes.

having_Sub_Domain.description: Counts subdomain levels in the domain part.
having_Sub_Domain.rule: 1 dot -> Legitimate (1), 2 dots -> Suspicious (0), > 2 dots -> Phishing (-1)
having_Sub_Domain.plain_explanation_phishing: Unusually deep subdomain hierarchy (> 2 subdomains), commonly used to mimic complex trusted paths.

SSLfinal_State.description: Evaluates SSL certificate trust issuer and validity lifespan.
SSLfinal_State.rule: Trusted CA + age >= 1 yr -> Legitimate (1), untrusted CA -> Suspicious (0), no SSL/expired -> Phishing (-1)
SSLfinal_State.plain_explanation_phishing: Missing, untrusted, or expired SSL certificate.
SSLfinal_State.plain_explanation_legit: Valid HTTPS with trusted Certificate Authority and verified lifespan.

Domain_registeration_length.description: Length of time until domain registration expires.
Domain_registeration_length.rule: Expires in <= 1 year -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
Domain_registeration_length.plain_explanation_phishing: Domain registered for only 1 year or near expiration, typical of disposable attack domains.
Domain_registeration_length.plain_explanation_legit: Long-term multi-year domain registration indicating established commitment.

Favicon.description: Checks if the site icon (favicon) is loaded from an external domain.
Favicon.rule: Favicon from external domain -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
Favicon.plain_explanation_phishing: Favicon loaded from external server, typical of cloned page templates.
Favicon.plain_explanation_legit: Favicon served locally from the host domain.

port.description: Checks if non-standard or dangerous network ports are open.
port.rule: Standard ports only -> Legitimate (1), non-standard open ports -> Phishing (-1)
port.plain_explanation_phishing: Host runs non-standard or vulnerable open ports.

HTTPS_token.description: Checks if 'https' token is embedded in the domain part of the URL.
HTTPS_token.rule: 'https' in domain part -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
HTTPS_token.plain_explanation_phishing: The token 'https' is deceptively added to the domain string (e.g. 'https-login.com').
HTTPS_token.plain_explanation_legit: No deceptive protocol token inside the domain name.

Request_URL.description: Percentage of external media (images/videos) loaded from foreign domains.
Request_URL.plain_explanation_phishing: Majority of page media loaded from external sources, indicating a scraped template.
Request_URL.plain_explanation_legit: Media assets predominantly hosted on origin domain.

URL_of_Anchor.description: Percentage of anchor (<a>) links leading to external domains or dummy targets.
URL_of_Anchor.plain_explanation_phishing: Most links point to dummy destinations ('#') or external untrusted domains.
URL_of_Anchor.plain_explanation_legit: Links point internally to legitimate site navigation.

Links_in_tags.description: Percentage of links in <meta>, <script>, and <link> tags pointing externally.
Links_in_tags.plain_explanation_phishing: High proportion of metadata tags linking outside the host domain.
Links_in_tags.plain_explanation_legit: Normal internal script and style sheet linkage.

SFH.description: Server Form Handler action attribute destination.
SFH.rule: Empty or 'about:blank' -> Phishing (-1), foreign domain -> Suspicious (0), internal -> Legitimate (1)
SFH.plain_explanation_phishing: Login form action is empty, about:blank, or submits to a different domain.
SFH.plain_explanation_legit: Form action posts securely to the verified origin host.

Submitting_to_email.description: Checks if form submission sends harvested data via mailto: or mail().
Submitting_to_email.plain_explanation_phishing: Form directly submits entered user data to an email address.
Submitting_to_email.plain_explanation_legit: No direct email harvesting handler detected.

Abnormal_URL.description: Checks if the host name matches the domain in WHOIS.
Abnormal_URL.rule: Host not recognized in WHOIS identity -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
Abnormal_URL.plain_explanation_phishing: URL host does not match WHOIS registry records.

Redirect.plain_explanation_phishing: Excessive redirection chains (> 4 hops) to evade automated scanners.
Redirect.plain_explanation_legit: Direct destination or single standard redirect.

on_mouseover.description: Checks if JavaScript alters browser status bar on hover.
on_mouseover.plain_explanation_phishing: JavaScript dynamically masks real destination in the browser status bar.
on_mouseover.plain_explanation_legit: No status bar tampering script detected.

RightClick.description: Checks if context menu (right click) is disabled via JS.
RightClick.plain_explanation_phishing: Right-clicking disabled to prevent user from viewing page source.

popUpWidnow.description: Detects popup windows containing credential inputs.
popUpWidnow.rule: Popup contains form fields -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
popUpWidnow.plain_explanation_phishing: Suspicious popup window demanding login credentials.

Iframe.description: Detects hidden or invisible iframes (e.g. frameBorder='0').
Iframe.rule: Invisible iframe present -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
Iframe.plain_explanation_phishing: Contains invisible iframe used for clickjacking or silent overlays.

age_of_domain.description: Age of domain since initial WHOIS creation.
age_of_domain.plain_explanation_phishing: Newly created domain (< 6 months), high risk of disposable phishing setup.
age_of_domain.plain_explanation_legit: Aged domain with established operational history.

DNSRecord.description: Checks if domain resolves in public DNS servers.
DNSRecord.rule: No DNS record -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
DNSRecord.plain_explanation_phishing: Domain has no valid DNS record, indicating a ghost or temporary host.

web_traffic.plain_explanation_phishing: Domain has virtually no global web traffic or popularity footprint.
web_traffic.plain_explanation_legit: High-traffic domain with widespread legitimate user base.

Page_Rank.plain_explanation_phishing: PageRank is 0 or extremely low, indicating an isolated, unlinked site.

Google_Index.description: Checks if webpage is indexed in Google search.
Google_Index.plain_explanation_phishing: Page is not indexed in search engines (frequent with short-lived attacks).
Google_Index.plain_explanation_legit: Verified indexed page in search engine results.

Links_pointing_to_page.description: Number of external web pages linking to this target.
Links_pointing_to_page.plain_explanation_phishing: Zero inbound links pointing to this page across the web.
Links_pointing_to_page.plain_explanation_legit: Multiple independent websites link to this domain.

Statistical_report.description: Matches host against known phishing intelligence feeds (PhishTank, StopBadware).
Statistical_report.rule: Host in phishing blacklist -> Phishing (-1), otherwise Legitimate (1)
Statistical_report.plain_explanation_phishing: Domain or IP address flagged in threat intelligence feeds.
Statistical_report.plain_explanation_legit: Clean reputation; not listed on active threat blacklists.
